_comment: Example committed contract for the WP/WC REST payloads a headless consumer reads. Copy into the CONSUMER repo (e.g. contract/wp-rest.json) and point the action's `manifest` input at it. Each entry describes ONE item's shape; a list endpoint is validated against its first element. Note the THREE presence tiers below — `required` (present AND non-null), `requiredNullable` (key always sent, null legitimate: absent ⇒ CRITICAL, null ⇒ silent), and `optional` (tolerated absent, null ⇒ WARN). Picking the wrong one is what turns the gate into weekly noise; see the README's 'Which presence tier?' table.
